senses.gloss:
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Unmixed, uncombined.
m. (-क्तः)
(In grammar) an affix of a single letter.
E.
अ neg. पृक्त combined.

ind.
With, together with, collectively.
E.
अ not, पृथक severally.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Unasked, unaddressed, not spoken to.
E.
अ neg. पृष्ट asked.

f. (-च्छा)
Conversation, speaking to or with.
E.
आङ्, प्रच्छ to ask, अङ् and टाप् affs.
